title: Something Is Digging a Tunnel in Your Skin Right Now

beats.say: Something is digging a tunnel in your skin right now.
Shrink down. It's a mite, laying eggs as it digs.
You won't even itch for a month.
Every tunnel is packed with eggs.
It spreads by touch. So... who did you touch today?
Subscribe. Next: the bug that rolls into a ball.
